Name: The Grampleton Maker's Market Letter (GMM)
Author: Elaho
Description:
[size=5][b]Welcome to The Grampleton Maker's Market!
[/b][/size]
[quote]﻿[size=4]**May 1, 2024:

White the Maker's Market Letter and Paisley's Bridal Boutique is now compatible with Stardew 1.6, the remaining Market Shops [Joseph's Seed Shop and Louvier Fromagerie] are are [b][i]NOT[/i][/b] yet compatible with the latest 1.6 update.
[/size]
But!! The next shop update [Joseph's Seed Shop] is expected to be launched in Summer 2024. I'll be updating pages on all mods connected to The Grampleton Maker's Market, including the Changelogs and Description  [Warning: Spoilers] as the transition takes place. In the meantime, follow my [url=http://elaho.tumblr.com/]Tumblr[/url]﻿ for more details and sneak peeks for what's to come. 

Thank you all for your patience and continued support  :)

-Elaho[/quote]

This mod is part of a larger mod-in-progress called “The Grampleton Maker’s Market”. It includes the letter players [b]MUST[/b] receive for the market stalls to appear in the town square. This mod is [b]MANDATORY[/b] for any Grampleton Maker's Market vendors/stalls to appear. Market stall mods are separate from this "letter" mod. Current market stalls include:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11446]- Paisley's Bridal Boutique (GMM)[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11676]- Joseph's Seed Shop (GMM)[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13422]- Louvier Fromagerie (GMM)[/url]

Each of these vendor mods can be played independently of each other, but all [b]MUST[/b] have this letter mod installed to work/appear. 

-- Please note that this version of "The Grampleton Maker's Market Letter (GMM)" is a demo version of the upcoming GMM mod expansion and only features a portion of what will be included in the main mod. --

[size=3]
[b]How to Receive the Maker's Market Letter: (Light Spoilers)[/b][/size]

Players must have upgraded their farmhouse to include a kitchen to have the Maker's Market letter appear in the mailbox. After Robin has upgraded your house, you will receive a letter from Lewis explaining the Maker’s Market. You MUST have read this letter for any (separately downloaded) stalls to appear.
After the letter has been read, vendors will set up their shops every 6th, 7th, 20th, and 21st of each month (except winter) in the Town Square. All shops will be open from 9 AM to 6 PM regardless of the weather.

[size=3][b]Mod Requirements and Compatibility:[/b]

[/size]The following mods must be installed for this mod to work properly:
-- SMAPI
-- Mail Framework Mod

[b][size=3]Donations[/size][/b]

The Grampleton Maker's Market is a free expansion pack for Stardew Valley and features a variety of new content to enhance your playthrough experience. With regular content updates, bug fixes, and transparent communication with the community, developing the Market to its full potential and adding additional shops, characters, and content takes a lot of time.

Please consider donating to me through [url=https://www.patreon.com/elaho]Patreon[/url].
